title: Pager Popen() should not use shell=True now that the command is a list
root_cause_summary: After Popen command arg was changed from string to list, shell=True was not updated to shell=False. On POSIX with shell=True and a sequence, shell only runs the first item and treats the rest as shell arguments, effectively swallowing command args.
notes: No double-quoted strings in issue but backtick strings present (shell=True, shell=False). With backtick extraction, errors.txt will contain shell=True. Error Sources will find it in _termui_impl.py. Most focused fix: 1 source file, 1 line changed.
